preconditions.description: The length of string s is at least 1 and at most 10^5.
The length of string t is at least 1 and at most 10^5.
The product of the lengths of strings s and t is at most 10^7.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum number of occurrences of string t in string s after replacing all the question marks with small Latin letters.
